findings.summary: The checked-in READY workflow order runs pytest before canonical --require-ready; pytest-created ignored caches then make the canonical clean-check fail even though the unchanged 76-test suite passes in both lifecycle states.
Exact frozen binding, a legitimate six-path READY/ACCEPT descendant and lifecycle-aware 76-test execution in both states were independently verified.
Prior metadata allowlist, history, lifecycle, acceptance, identifier, Git-context, byte, mode and capability controls remain fail closed.

construct and validate metadata-only READY/ACCEPT descendant
replay exact workflow command order under READY
verify allowed paths, regular blobs, prior history and capability bindings
verify protected scopes and git diff --check
conclusion: Round 11 supports both lifecycle states, but its workflow order blocks a legitimate READY transition after pytest dirties ignored cache paths. Validator-integrity remains CHANGES_REQUIRED.
